# License

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:License`](gmeow-License.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/License>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

A licence granting rights in a work — modelled as a [`gmeow:Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md) (it binds licensor and licensee and creates permissions / duties). The canonical superset of [cc:License](http://creativecommons.org/ns#License) / an ODRL Offer / [dcterms:LicenseDocument.](http://purl.org/dc/terms/LicenseDocument.) Its validity window rides [`gmeow:validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md); its family is a [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](../properties/gmeow-licenseFamily.md) value.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:License`](gmeow-License.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
